united_earth_is_1: Baninzi kakhulu abantu abafuna ukusindisa iplanethi yethu. Imibutho emininzi, imibutho, iinkampani kunye nabantu abangatshatanga. Kodwa asazi omnye komnye.
united_earth_is_3: Kufuneka sinxibelelane omnye nomnye ukubonisa indlela enamandla ngayo intshukumo yethu. Ukuba siyazi ukuba sibaninzi, sinokunceda abantu ukuba batshintshe iimvakalelo zabo kutshintsho lwemozulu ukuze babe nesibindi nokuzithemba. Singabanika abantu amandla okuba baqale ngokwabo amanyathelo okhuseleko lwemozulu. Sisonke kuphela esinokuthi sitshintshe umhlaba kwaye sihlangule imozulu!
united_earth_is_4: Guqula umhlaba ngokubhalisa kwiwebhusayithi yethu! Singabona baninzi!
united_earth_is_5: Siyakumema ngokufudumeleyo ukuba wabelane ngolwazi olu kunye nabahlobo, amaqabane kunye nabahlobo.
united_earth_is_7: Abafundi abangama-200 nootitshala abangama-30 kwisikolo saseOstriya
about_us_2: Ukuba sibonisa ukuba sibaninzi, sinokubanceda abantu ukuba batshintshe iimvakalelo zabo kutshintsho lwemozulu ukusuka ekuphelelweni ukuya kwinkalipho nokuzithemba. Singabanika abantu amandla okuba baqale ngokwabo amanyathelo okhuseleko lwemozulu.
about_us_3: Kodwa ngaphezulu kwako konke: Asisayi kuziva sodwa kwaye singenamandla kwakhona. Ingasidibanisa. Ingasinika ithemba, ukomelela, isibindi kunye nokuzithemba. Singaziva sinxibelelene nawo wonke umhlaba-sisindisa iplanethi yethu kwaye sisebenzela ikamva elingcono.
about_us_4: Injongo yethu kukunika abantu isibindi, ukuzithemba kunye namandla okuqala amanyathelo abo okhuseleko lwemozulu.
about_us_5: Qaphela: Akukho mfazwe ngenxa yeembono ezahlukeneyo- ukugwetywa, hayi ukunyanzelwa kufuneka ibe sisiseko sokukhusela iplanethi yethu.
about_us_6: Abantu abali-100, bonke bethetha iilwimi ezahlukeneyo, bahamba ngesikhephe besiya ngakwimpophoma. Phantse wonke umntu esikhepheni uyayazi imeko eyingozi. Kodwa phantse wonke umntu ucinga ukuba inguye kuphela owaziyo ngayo. "Ndingenza ntoni?", Wonke umntu ucinga. "Ukuhamba kwelinye icala akunamsebenzi!" Kwaye wonke umntu uzibandakanya kwindlela yesiqhelo yokuziphatha yexesha elidlulileyo. Kuya kwenzeka ntoni ukuba ngequbuliso wonke umntu ebesazi malunga nomnye - esazi ukuba wonke umntu ufuna ukubuyela umva kwaye banokunxibelelana?
about_us_9: Iwebhusayithi kunye namaphepha eendaba ezentlalo axhunyiwe ayenziwe ngabafundi abangama-200 kunye nootitshala kwisikolo saseOstriya.
about_us_10: Le projekthi yenziwa njengeprojekhthi yokuya kwi-ecolabel yase-Austrian. Zonke izinto zewebhusayithi zenziwe njengeprojekthi yesikolo.
about_us_11: Singalandela iinkolo ezahlukeneyo, sahlukile ngeminyaka nangemvelaphi, kodwa sonke sifuna ukusindisa iplanethi yethu. Bonke abathathi-nxaxheba bangamavolontiya.

ws_saving_earth_text: Imeko yomhlaba wethu iya yawohloka ngendlela ebabazekayo, yanda imbalela, izikhukula, izaqhwithi, ukunyibilika kwamaza amakhulu eqhwa, ukunyuka kwamazinga olwandle, ukutshisa amahlathi, ityhefu yemilambo kunye namachibi, iintaba zenkunkuma emhlabeni kunye naselwandle kunye namawaka eentaka zezilwanyana kunye nezityalo. Umhlaba wethu ufikelele kumda wobukho bawo. Sifuna ukugcina iplanethi yethu ngaphambi kokuba kube kudala.
ws_peace_text: Injongo yethu kukuhlangana ngokuthula kwabo bonke abantu nabantu kwiplanethi yethu. Sifuna uncedo kunye nenkxaso. Simele ukwamkelana kunye nentlonipho. Siyaziqonda iimfuno zabanye abantu. Sisisisombululo soxolo seembambano. Senzelwe ukukhululeka ekubandezelekeni nentlungu. Kwaye sinolwalamano olunoxolo phakathi kwabantu bonke.
ws_forests_text: Silukhuselo lwamahlathi ethu nokukhusela ulwandle. Singokhuselo lwemilambo yethu kunye namachibi. Senzelwe ukugcina imeko yethu icocekile kwaye nokugcina umgangatho ucocekile. Kwaye siyaluqonda unxibelelwano phakathi kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezinabantu, izilwanyana kunye nezityalo. Ukuba amahlathi ethu kunye nolwandle luyafa, siya kufa. Akukho nto ikhoyo ngokuzimela.
ws_science_text: Senzelwe isayensi kunye nophando olusebenzela abantu kunye nomhlaba. Kwitekhnoloji, kwizifundo zesayensi, kwezenzululwazi kwezentlalo nakwezomthetho, kwezolimo nakumahlathi, amayeza kunye nophando kunye nesayensi ngokubanzi. Kuphela kungokuzinikela kunye nentsebenziswano yethu wonke umntu esinokuthi sinqande ukuguquguquka, ukufudumeza ngokukhawuleza okungaphezulu kwe-2 ° C.
ws_greenhouse_text: Akukho naluphi na uhlahlo-lwabiwo mali lwe-CO2 esele lukhona thina bantu kufuneka silukhuphele emoyeni. Nangona kunjalo, ukukhutshwa kwegesi yokuluhlaza eluhlaza emhlabeni kuyanda kwaye uxinzelelo lweegesi zokugcina luhlaza kwindawo yomoya ziyanda kakhulu. Ezi gasi zilandelayo zegreenhouse zinoxanduva lokufudumala komhlaba. Ikhabhoni diokside CO2, methane CH4 - Into 30, nitrous oxide N2O - factor 300, HFC-ukuya kuma-300,000 amaxesha)
ws_co2_text: Ukuxinana kweegesi zegreenhouse kwimozulu sele kuphakeme kangangokuba ubushushu obuyi-1.5 ° C nangaphaya kuya kwenzeka. Nangona kunjalo, ukubakho kwesiphumo se-Domino (iingcebiso) kufuneka kuthintelwe. Ke kufuneka sivelise igasethi eninzi eluhlaza ngaphandle komoya njengoko kunokwenzeka. Ngokutyala imithi, ukudala izithuba eziluhlaza kunye nokunye okuninzi.
ws_animals_text: Phakathi kwe-1 000 ne-10 000 iintlobo zezilwanyana ziyafa nyaka ngamnye. Ama-75% ezinambuzane ezinamaphiko asweleke kule minyaka ingama-25 idlulileyo. Ukongeza ukufudumala, i-acidization elwandle yi-CO2 echithakeleyo yenye yeengxaki ezinkulu. Oku kukhokelela ekuwohlokeni kwentlekele yobomi bonke baselwandle. Ukuba amahlathi ethu, izilwanyana, izityalo kunye nolwandle ziyafa, akukho ikamva lethu thina bantu.
ws_preparing_text: Ukunyuka kobushushu obumgangatho wehlabathi ngoku kujikeleze i-1.4 ° C kwaye kuya kunyuka ukuya kwi-1.5 ° C ngo-2029. Ukuba onke amazwe, ukuya kuthi ga kwelinye, ukuziqhelanisa nokukhuselwa kwemozulu okunzulu, sinokulinganisela ubushushu kwi2 ° C. Iintlekele zokusingqongileyo, ukunqongophala kokutya namanzi kunye nokupheliswa kweentlobo zezinto eziphilayo kuya kunyuka kakhulu. Bonke abantu bajongene nemiceli mngeni ngendlela engazange ibonwe.
ws_awareness_text: Ngelishwa, bambalwa kakhulu abantu abayaziyo indlela embi ngayo iplanethi yethu. Ngaba asifuni sonke ikamva eliqinisekileyo nabazali bethu, abantwana bethu, abazukulwana bethu, izalamane nabahlobo? Ngaba asifanele sihleke nabo, sibabambe kwaye sizive sonwabile? Kufuneka sitshintshe kwindlela elungileyo. Makhe sabelane nabanye ngalo myalezo ngesibindi, ngokuzithemba nangothando.
